Take Cal. He knows which noises are machinery and which are opinions.

Both. Jump the low hurdles. Duck the high ones. Then take a break.

objects.name: Mara / a familiar face

Listen: the squeak beyond that door is trying to say somebody's name.

objects.name: Bowling lanes / rolling stars

For once, I support a machine with a boundary.

A promise with an ending. Pin Pal could use one of those.

Pin Pal wants a practice partner. One round can be a complete promise.

objects.name: Ball return / the same request

We should ask what one round means before agreeing to play forever.

A club notice that can admit a mistake. Promising.

objects.name: Lobby fireplace

objects.name: Ping-pong table

objects.name: Fountain bench / save

In dumplings. Which, honestly, is a better currency than Buff Bucks. Don't tell the Book Store.

objects.name: Frisbee kid

Do you ever get them back?
In May, when facilities drains it. It's like Christmas, but wetter.

objects.name: Orientation volunteer
lines: Welcome to campus! If you're lost, the answer is usually 'the other building.'
Then you should know it by now. Still the other building, though.

objects.name: Philosophy major
lines: If a bench is empty and nobody sits on it, is it still a bench?
See, that's the kind of answer that gets you a B. I respect it.

objects.name: Hacky-sack hippie
lines: It's a circle of two right now. We're recruiting. The sack doesn't judge.
Bathroom. Long-term bathroom. We believe in him.

objects.name: Business major
lines: Do you have a LinkedOut? I'll connect with anyone. It's a numbers game and I'm losing.
How many connections do you have?
Four thousand. Zero of them know my middle name. I'm working on it.

objects.name: Professor / office hours
lines: Office hours moved outdoors. It's a trend. Nobody comes, but the fountain is lovely.
Is that a syllabus on your bench?
It's the syllabus. It's also lunch. We're a very efficient department.

objects.name: Engineering major / in line
lines: Four exams this week and a cold brew. I'd say the cold brew is winning.
Long enough to finish a problem set. I did. It's wrong, but it's finished.

objects.name: Cyclist / locking up
lines: Three locks, one chain, and I forgot my keys. Technically it's very secure.
It's in a very secure relationship with the bike rack. I'll be here a while.

objects.name: Athlete / stretching
lines: Stretching is ninety percent of the workout and nobody believes me.

objects.name: Runner / catching breath
lines: Altitude. It gets you. Four years in and I still gasp at the fountain.
I could. I won't. Don't ask me why. I don't have breath for it.

lines: Forty new copies of the same calculus book, and one used copy with somebody's answers already in it.

objects.name: AISLE 1 / required reading
lines: Every course on campus, shrink-wrapped. The access codes cost extra.

objects.name: AISLE 2 / used books
lines: USED. Highlighted in four colours by four people who all stopped at chapter three.

objects.name: Buffs gear wall
lines: Hoodies in black and gold, BUFFS across every chest in case anyone forgets where they are.

objects.name: Folded tees
lines: Perfect stacks. Somebody refolds them every time anyone breathes nearby.

objects.name: Bin of plush Ralphies
lines: A bin of plush buffaloes. One has been put back upside down, which feels personal.

objects.name: Checkout / register
lines: The customer screen says $0.00 and THANK YOU, GO BUFFS. The receipt roll is nearly out.

objects.name: Cashier / closing shift

objects.name: Sticker spinner
lines: Stickers, postcards and a magnet shaped like the Flatirons. The spinner squeaks on every turn.

objects.name: SELL YOUR BOOKS
lines: TEXTBOOK BUYBACK. They pay a little for what cost a lot.

objects.name: BARGAIN BOOKS $1

objects.name: STAFF ONLY
lines: STAFF ONLY. Somewhere back there is every textbook nobody bought.

objects.name: Store hours
lines: OPEN LATE THIS WEEK. Somebody added a sad face in pen.

That's a lot for a pen.
The pen was twelve dollars. The sticker was a bargain.

objects.name: LinkedOut kiosk
lines: A big touchscreen that says WELCOME BACK, JULES. It already knows me.

objects.name: Advisor's desk
lines: A nameplate, a bowl of mints and a four-year plan with year four still blank.

objects.name: Career advisor / walk-in hours

Then you're right on time. The best time to worry about a career is the night before the ceremony. Try the LinkedOut kiosk.

objects.name: Career fair table
lines: PEAKLINE IS HIRING. Free pens, free stress balls, no salary listed.

objects.name: Recruiter / career fair table

Synergy. Mostly synergy. Take a tote bag, it's the best thing we make.

objects.name: JOBS board
lines: Internships, barista shifts, a lab that needs a volunteer, and a tear-off tab that says EXPERIENCE: 5 YEARS.

objects.name: Brochure rack
lines: RESUMES. INTERVIEWS. MAJORS. Somebody took every copy of WHAT NOW?

lines: Campus at night. Every window still lit belongs to somebody writing a cover letter.

objects.name: Water cooler
lines: A paper cone of water. The most free thing in this room.

objects.name: FREE HEADSHOTS

objects.name: Name tags
lines: HELLO MY NAME IS. Somebody has written ASPIRING and nothing else.

objects.name: RESUME REVIEW sign

objects.name: Recycling bin

objects.name: Scooter on its side

objects.name: Parked hatchback
lines: A hatchback with a parking ticket and a CU parking sticker from three years ago.

objects.name: COLLEGE AVE
lines: COLLEGE AVE. Downhill is campus. Uphill is every bad idea in Boulder.

objects.name: Tanner / the rush chair

The bag in the tree. It's been up there since September.

Pivots. We're a pivot company now. Don't tell the investors it's circular.

objects.name: Kyle / founder, CEO, visionary
lines: ...A family that's worked out what the product does. I wrote it on a sticky note. It's on the fridge.

objects.name: The snack wall
lines: Eleven kinds of almonds, four kinds of jerky, a whole bin of something called PROTEIN DUST. Not one sandwich.

objects.name: Kombucha on tap
lines: Three taps: GINGER, HIBISCUS, and one with tape over it that says KYLE'S SCOBY. DO NOT.

objects.name: The sticker fridge
lines: Stickers on top of stickers: a mountain, a ski hill, three startups that don't exist any more. The fridge is holding them up.

objects.name: Espresso machine
lines: It cost more than a semester. The screen says DESCALE ME, and has for a while.

objects.name: Four bins
lines: COMPOST, RECYCLE, LANDFILL, and a fourth bin labelled EQUITY. It's empty.

objects.name: The beanbag / rest and save
lines: You sink in a little too far. Nobody will find you here for a while. A good place to stop.

objects.name: Sink / a note
lines: WASH YOUR OWN MUG. Underneath, in different handwriting: KYLE. Underneath that: ESPECIALLY KYLE.

objects.name: Back window
lines: Over the alley and the rooftops, the Flatirons are black against the last of the sky.

objects.name: High-top table
lines: Two stools, one laptop sticker per square inch, and a mug that says WORLD'S OKAYEST FOUNDER.

objects.name: Foosball table
lines: One of the blue goalies has been superglued facing the wrong way. Nobody will say who did it.

objects.name: The office dog
lines: The office dog is asleep. His bed says SEED ROUND. Nobody wakes him for stand-up.

objects.name: Neon / GOOD VIBES
lines: GOOD VIBES, in mint neon. The O flickers on the hour.

objects.name: Coworker / pouring a kombucha
lines: Kombucha's free. It's also, I think, alive. Don't make eye contact.
That's just the fridge. The kombucha is the one that's breathing.

objects.name: Coworker / at the high-top
lines: Foosball is how we hold performance reviews. I'm down four to nothing, so, promotion pending.
The dog. He doesn't cheat. He also doesn't play.
